evidence.reason: `schema_problem` promises to return the first violation rather than raise, but it indexes `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]` without validating `t`. A deployment-supplied local-review schema containing a valid JSON Schema type absent from `_SCHEMA_TYPES` (for example `number`) makes this raise `KeyError` instead of reporting an invalid/unverified receipt, so the helper can break the health path rather than fail closed as documented. Validate type names before lookup and return a schema-problem string for unsupported types.
